title: 第3章 坊市第4章 回矿区第5章 变现
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
走在通往内城的道路上，秦怀安观察着坊市的建筑。外城大多都是类似于他租住的房屋，一排排密集排布，之间仅留丈许的道路，密密麻麻但又整齐有序。
当靠近内城时，逐渐出现了一些独栋带院的建筑，道路也变得更加宽敞起来。
云田坊的交易场所都设置在内城，内城交易受到黄山剑宗的保护，不得强买强卖。
大约半个时辰后，秦怀安进入了内城。
街道上已是熙熙攘攘，两侧店铺林立。路边也摆满摊位，售卖着各种灵草、炼器材料、丹药、法器、符箓等修炼资源。
“辟谷丹，辟谷丹，独家配方，口味独特！”
“神行符、灵火符、金刚符，出门在外，必备良品！”
“道友来看看，价格优惠！”
......
叫卖声不绝于耳。
秦怀安需要补充一些辟谷丹。他不打算在路边摊位买，而是直奔平时打零工和出售灵草的丹霞阁。
丹霞阁是专门从事丹药售卖的店铺，同时也收购、售卖灵草。
丹霞阁在云田坊有好几家分店，是一家较大的丹药店。他去的就是其中的一家分店。
走进丹霞阁，迎面跑来一个八九岁的小女孩，身穿杏黄衣衫，肌肤粉雕玉琢，双眸闪亮显得十分灵动。
“秦哥哥，你都好几天没来找灵芸玩了！”小姑娘开心的跑到秦怀安身边说道。她是薛掌柜的孙女，秦怀安这几年经常来这里，小女孩很喜欢缠着秦怀安陪她玩。
秦怀安也不知道为什么小姑娘这么喜欢和原主玩，莫非是因为这具英俊的皮囊？不应该啊，小姑娘才八九岁，或者是原主那和善的笑容？
“灵芸！”薛掌柜迎了上来，朝小姑娘瞪了一眼。小灵芸吐吐舌头，转身到旁边自己玩去了。
随后薛掌柜笑道：“秦小友又有药材出售吗？”
“不是的，薛掌柜，我来购买一些辟谷丹。”
“这样啊，要多少呢？”

“要四瓶，这是2块灵石。”
薛掌柜接过灵石，对伙计说道：“王贵，拿五瓶辟谷丹给秦小友。”
伙计王贵取来五瓶辟谷丹，略有不爽的递给秦怀安。哼，一个临时工，也不知道掌柜的怎么对他这么好。
“薛掌柜，这......”秦怀安嘴上迟疑着，手已经伸过去接过那五瓶丹药。
“哈哈哈，秦小友以后采到药材继续卖给我们丹霞阁就可以了。”薛掌柜看到秦怀安毫不迟疑的接过丹药，眼中微露诧异，随后哈哈笑道。
这秦小友几天不见，少了很多青涩啊。
“一定一定，那晚辈就不多打扰了。”秦怀安朝薛掌柜拱拱手说道。
见秦怀安要走，小灵芸急忙跑过拉住他的衣袖，“秦哥哥，陪灵芸玩一会儿嘛，再给我讲讲百万大山里的故事。”
秦怀安蹲下身，面容和煦，微笑道：“小灵芸努力修炼，等你长大了就可以自己出去见世面了。哥哥还有事，下次再和你玩哦。”
薛灵芸小姑娘资质不错，小小年纪就已经引气入体。过几年宗门招收的时候，有希望进入宗门修炼。
......
秦怀安告别了薛掌柜和薛灵芸后，出了丹霞阁。往外城走的路上，他在路边看到一个卖炼器材料的摊位，这个摊位摆着十多块大大小小的材料。
秦怀安指着其中一块问道：“道友，这个矿石怎么卖？”
content_en:
Walking on the road leading to the inner city, Qin Huaian observed the buildings in Fangshi. Most of the houses in the outer city are similar to the ones he rented, densely arranged in rows, with only a few feet of road between them, densely packed but neat and orderly.
As we approach the inner city, some single-family buildings with courtyards gradually appear, and the roads become wider.
The trading venues of Yuntianfang are all set up in the inner city. The transactions in the inner city are protected by the Huangshan Sword Sect and no forced buying or selling is allowed.
About half an hour later, Qin Huaian entered the inner city.
The street is already bustling with people, and there are many shops on both sides. There are also stalls on the roadside, selling various spiritual herbs, weapon refining materials, elixirs, magic tools, talismans and other cultivation resources.
"Bigu Dan, Bigu Dan, exclusive formula, unique taste!"
"The divine walking talisman, the spiritual fire talisman, and the diamond talisman are all must-have products when you go out!"
"Fellow Taoist, come and take a look, the price is favorable!"
...
The sound of selling is endless.
Qin Huaian needs to add some Bigu Pills. He didn't plan to buy it at a roadside stall, but went straight to Danxia Pavilion where he usually worked odd jobs and sold spiritual herbs.
Danxia Pavilion is a shop that specializes in selling elixirs. It also purchases and sells spiritual herbs.
Danxia Pavilion has several branches in Yuntianfang and is a larger elixir shop. It was one of the branches he went to.
Walking into Danxia Pavilion, a little girl of eight or nine years old ran towards her. She was wearing an apricot yellow dress, her skin was pink and jade-like, and her eyes were shining and she looked very smart.
"Brother Qin, you haven't come to play with Lingyun for several days!" The little girl happily ran to Qin Huaian and said. She is the granddaughter of shopkeeper Xue. Qin Huaian has come here often in the past few years. The little girl likes to pester Qin Huaian to play with her.
Qin Huaian didn't know why the little girl liked playing with the original owner so much. Could it be because of this handsome body? It shouldn’t be, the little girl is only eight or nine years old, or is it the original owner’s kind smile?
"Lingyun!" Shopkeeper Xue came forward and glared at the little girl. Little Lingyun stuck out her tongue, turned around and went to play by herself.
Then shopkeeper Xue smiled and said, "Little friend Qin, do you have any medicinal materials for sale?"
"No, Shopkeeper Xue, I'm here to buy some Bigu Pills."
"That's it, how much does it cost?"
"I want four bottles, here are two spiritual stones."
Shopkeeper Xue took the spirit stone and said to the waiter: "Wang Gui, give five bottles of Bigu Pill to Xiaoyou Qin."
The clerk Wang Gui took five bottles of Bigu Pills and handed them to Qin Huaian with a little displeasure. Huh, a temporary worker, I don’t know why the shopkeeper is so nice to him.
"Shopkeeper Xue, this..." Qin Huaian hesitated, but his hand had already reached out to take the five bottles of pills.
"Hahaha, little friend Qin can just collect the medicinal materials and sell them to us at Danxia Pavilion." Shopkeeper Xue saw Qin Huaian taking the elixir without hesitation, his eyes showed surprise, and then he laughed.
I haven't seen this little friend Qin for a few days, and he has lost a lot of youthfulness.
"Absolutely, I won't bother you anymore, junior." Qin Huaian said, cupping his hands towards Shopkeeper Xue.
Seeing Qin Huaian about to leave, Xiao Lingyun hurriedly ran over and grabbed his sleeve, "Brother Qin, play with Lingyun for a while, and then tell me the story of Million Mountains."
Qin Huaian knelt down, with a kind face, and said with a smile: "Little Lingyun, practice hard. When you grow up, you can go out and see the world by yourself. Brother, I still have something to do, I will play with you next time."
The little girl Xue Lingyun has good qualifications, and she has already introduced Qi into her body at a young age. When the sect recruits people in a few years, there is hope that they can enter the sect and practice.
...
After Qin Huaian said goodbye to shopkeeper Xue and Xue Lingyun, he left Danxia Pavilion. On the way to the outer city, he saw a stall selling weapon-refining materials on the roadside. This stall had more than ten pieces of materials, large and small.
Qin Huaian pointed to one of the pieces and asked, "Fellow Taoist, how can I sell this ore?"
